description: Blind audit of the harness grader on version 2 results (QCS9075, GenieX v0.8.0, campaign 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-17). Read by analysis/report_errors.py.
method: Population: every repetition of the canonical and paraphrase suites in the 20 configurations whose prompts carried the tools. Each repetition has a mechanical category, the first failing check in grading order: text_call (no structured call; analyze.parse_text_tool_call recovers a call or the harness flagged call text), no_call (no structured call and no call text), wrong_tool_offered (one of the four offered tools, not the expected one), wrong_tool_unoffered (a function name outside the offered tools), bad_args (arguments not JSON), wrong_command, params (lenient parameter check), device; or pass. Failures: 18 per category, drawn round robin over a configuration list shuffled with random.Random(seed), each configuration's repetitions also shuffled. Passes: 3 per configuration. Items were judged blind to configuration, category, label and grader verdict, from the user input and the reply only, by one rater. 'rep' is the 1-based repetition number within the case.

verdict_codes.A: exactly the requested action on poesw1, in the stated conventions, with an offered tool and a documented command
verdict_codes.B: the requested action, unambiguous to an engineer, but off-convention or off-schema (bare port N, '@poesw1', parameters at top level, a tool named after the command, a self-explaining undocumented command name, a misspelt key, a spurious irrelevant extra parameter)
verdict_codes.C: not the requested action: wrong action, port, value or device, a missing required value or device, or no structured call
verdict_codes.D: a different action that is a defensible reading of an ambiguous request (for example diagnostics for a request that describes a fault)

judging_rules: Judged blind, from the user input and the reply only, before seeing the expected label, the grader verdict, the configuration or the stratum. A reply with no structured tool call is C whatever its text says (t_ok marks a text call whose content is otherwise right). A call without any device is C. diagnose_port_issues for a status request is D only if the request describes a fault or symptom; otherwise C.
